summary: Runs a three-word feedback shift register over each byte of the input buffer, rotating state words at this[3..6], then writes the processed buffer to the file descriptor stored at *this via FileReadWrapperWithLock.

operations.description: Iterate over a3 bytes of the buffer at a2; the loop counter runs from 0 while less than a3.
Compute v4 multiplied by the byte at a2+i plus this[6] (offset 0x18), yielding the new accumulator v5.
Shift state: this[3] (offset 0x0C) takes the value of this[4] (offset 0x10).
Store the accumulator v5 into this[6] (offset 0x18).
Shift state: this[4] (offset 0x10) takes the value of v6 (previous this[5]).
Loop increment: this[5] (offset 0x14) takes the value of v4.
Call FileReadWrapperWithLock with the buffer, its length, a constant 1, and the file descriptor stored at *this (offset 0x00).
